start.heroDesc: A local-first personal stream workbench: capture into Inbox / stream, grow topics, deliver outputs, and keep long-term facts in memory. Files are the source of truth — open them in any editor.

steps.title: Open or create a workspace
steps.body: Use the bottom-left workspace menu to pick a local folder. New workspaces seed category structure (Inbox · Stream · Topics · Delivery · Archive). Your folder is the workspace — not a cloud account.

steps.title: Note it
steps.body: ⌘N or Note it in the sidebar: by default it appends to this week’s stream note; you can force Inbox or a standalone file. Global ⌘⇧N works from any app.

steps.title: Configure AI (optional)
steps.body: Settings → Agent → AI: pick provider/model and API key. Without it the app is fully usable manually; with it you get chat, organize suggestions, and todo maintenance.

steps.title: Install companions (optional)
steps.body: Settings → Integrations: Agent Skills, Clip extension, Obsidian plugin. Ingest local tools can be installed from their settings when needed.

steps.title: Daily loop
steps.body: Capture → Keep working → Deliver/remember → Find/adjust. Tools & Logs shows usage, ops log, health, and cleanup ideas.

features.heroDesc: Built for a low-friction personal stream: few concepts, concrete files, recoverable mistakes.

items.title: Capture
items.body: One line into the weekly stream note; heavier material to Inbox or a topic. Web clip extension and paste paths supported.

items.title: Stream · Inbox · Delivery
items.body: Primary nav: stream is the default canvas; Inbox is the buffer; Delivery (88) holds flat outputs. Archive is reachable but not a primary peer.

items.title: Topics
items.body: Create a topic folder only for strong themes (topic.md + notes). Stream stays flat by default.

items.title: AI copilot
items.body: Right column: Chat / Suggestions / List / Apps. Suggestions generate by default and apply on confirm; the list is your personal list.

items.title: My profile (memory)
items.body: Profile and periodic reflections live on the memory plane. Facts can be appended, updated, or retired — after confirm, never silent rewrites.

items.title: Tools & Logs
items.body: Workspace usage, operations log, system log, health (including contract), cleanup and duplicate previews.

items.title: Optional connectors
items.body: WeRead, X, bookkeeping, Ingest — enable when you need them; off by default from the main path.

items.title: Safe writes
items.body: Default write access inside the workspace; AI cannot overwrite locked files; backups only for high-impact ops. Copy matches real recoverability.

workflow.heroDesc: Capture → Keep working → Deliver/remember → Find/adjust. Product vocabulary stays tiny.

stages.title: Capture
stages.body: Note it, clip, Ingest, connectors. Default lands in the stream period note or Inbox without breaking focus.

stages.title: Keep working
stages.body: Edit in stream/topics; AI can rewrite selections and discuss mounted files; confirm-gated suggestions organize Inbox and extract list items.

stages.title: Deliver / remember
stages.body: Outputs go to 88-Delivery (flat names); long-term facts to memory; research notes stay in topics.

stages.title: Find / adjust
stages.body: Search, tree, archive; Tools & Logs for health; lock critical notes against accidental edits.

dirs: memory/ — semantic plane: profile · reflections · list

philosophy.heroDesc: For a personal dynamic stream — not project management or a general coding agent.

points.title: Files are truth
points.body: Markdown lives in your folder; open it in Obsidian, VS Code, or git. App state is rebuildable and never cages your content.

points.title: Default access, clear fences
points.body: Tools and agents may read/write inside the workspace by default; outside paths and destructive acts ask first. Backups stay minimal (high-impact only).

points.title: Suggestions ≠ auto-apply
points.body: The system can propose organize, list, and memory changes — you confirm before write. AI cannot overwrite locked notes.

points.title: Optional depth
points.body: AI, UTR, Skills, connectors, Obsidian are optional surfaces. Capture and folders still work without them.

points.title: Honest copy
points.body: If something is recoverable we say so; we do not claim every delete is archived. Logs and receipts are bounded and clearable.

philosophy.closing: User concepts stay few: Note it · Stream · Topics · My profile · Delivery. Everything else is optional depth.

faq.heroDesc: AI setup, dependencies, plugins, and data safety.

items.a: Settings → Agent → AI: choose a provider/model, paste an API key, save. You can switch models per chat. Without AI the app is fully usable manually. Keys stay on this machine (Desktop state, safeStorage when available).

Durable writes go through the write gate: fenced to the workspace; AI cannot overwrite protection: locked files; confirm mode requires approval. Ordinary edits do not auto-backup; locked overwrites and core deletes land under 99-Archive and can be restored via Tools & Logs / restore receipts.

When Ingest needs local converters, use Settings → Ingest → local tools (probe/install). Agent Skills, Clip, and Obsidian plugin install from Settings → Integrations. Everyday note-taking needs no extra dependencies.
Settings → Plugins enables WeRead, X, bookkeeping, etc. Settings → Integrations installs Clip and Obsidian. Connector writes still follow the same conventions and write gate.

Content is in the local folder you chose. Desktop runtime state (settings, logs, session cache) lives in the local app state folder and can be deleted without losing notes. Workspace content is not uploaded unless you use network features (AI / fetch).

Back up the folder with your usual tools (Time Machine, sync, git). In-app backups are limited rotating copies for high-impact ops only (see Tools & Logs). Prefer a versioned or regularly synced workspace location.

items.q: I deleted something — can I restore?
items.a: Ordinary open notes usually delete without trash (honest product policy). Locked or core notes (memory, topic home, delivery) go to 99-Archive trash and can be restored via Tools & Logs or UTR list-safety-receipts / restore. Lock important notes.
Yes. The workspace is a plain Markdown folder. Optionally install the Obsidian plugin for a stream view; without it, open the same folder in Obsidian directly.

items.q: How do I change theme / language?
items.a: Bottom-left workspace menu toggles theme and language; full preferences live in Settings → General. Workspace template and categories are under Settings → Workspace.
Workspace menu → Tools & Logs: health (contract status), system log, ops log. Settings → Manage → Diagnostics runs the full doctor. Package the logs folder if you need to report an issue.
